characterization_methods.key_findings: Rounded/polygonal γ (austenite) particles sit in an α (ferrite) matrix, each γ outlined by a dark, scalloped, lobed κ rim
characterization_methods.purpose: show κ-phase precipitation at austenite/ferrite interfaces

characterization_methods.key_findings: 3D ridge of κ-phase plates/laths growing from and roughly perpendicular to a flat central γ plate embedded in α

interfaces.interface_notes: In three dimensions, the j-phase grows along the long axis of austenite
interfaces.phase_evolution: During cooling from the two-phase domain, the j-phase precipitates at the austenite/ferrite interface, with j-phase and ferrite forming a nonlamellar eutectoid

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Cooling down from 1400 °C at 10 °C/s from the two-phase domain

phases_present.morphology: rounded/polygonal particles embedded in the ferrite matrix
dark, scalloped, lobed rim outlining each austenite particle

precipitates.distribution: at austenite/ferrite interfaces, forming rims around austenite particles

phases_present.morphology: matrix embedding the γ plate and κ ridge
3D ridge of plates/laths growing from and roughly perpendicular to the flat central γ plate

precipitates.distribution: plates/laths growing from and roughly perpendicular to a flat central γ plate

structures.overall_structure: Two-phase austenite (γ)-ferrite (α) microstructure with κ-phase (j-phase) precipitated at austenite/ferrite interfaces, forming a nonlamellar eutectoid
